items: line-interactive UPS with AVR, EMI/RFI filtering and pure sine wave output
why: ChatGPT's answer treats this as a one-product purchase: it recommends a single UPS (CyberPower CP1500PFCLCD, APC SMT1500C or Tripp Lite SMART1500LCDT) that combines battery backup, AVR and filtering, and names no accessory the shopper must add.
